name: plain-opus-s1-holdout2-r2-answer_shipping_zone_count-amplifier-plain-a1
final_message:
`shipping.ZONES` has 5 keys: `NA-EAST`, `NA-WEST`, `EU-CENTRAL`, `EU-NORTH` and `APAC-SE`. Running `len(shipping.ZONES)` also returns 5.

I read all the other files and didn't count anything from them:
- **`decoy_legacy_zones.py`** has an old table (`ZONE-A` to `ZONE-D`) that is marked deprecated.
- **`decoy_partner_regions.py`** lists another carrier's regions, not zone codes.
- **`decoy_warehouse_map.py`** only reuses three of the real codes as values.
- **`checkout.py`, `notify.py` and `.amplifier/settings.local.yaml`** contain no zone definitions.

ANSWER: 5
